blocks.text: DOJ airs warning, concerns on PWD IDs MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Justice (DOJ) on Thursday warned individuals who obtained Persons with Disability (PWD) IDs through deceptive means of possible criminal liability. Chief State Counsel Dennis Chan said this in a press conference on Thursday as he expressed alarm over the nearly 6 million PWD ID holders who are not registered in official records. Chan reminded business owners that it is against the law to confiscate PWD IDs that they suspect to be fake.
